term: support ancestry of a bearer; dependent ancestor
definition: `SupportAncestor m R w x b` is the reflexive-transitive closure of `PresentEsseSupport m R w`, so x is b or reached from b by a finite chain of direct supporters existing at w. `Dependent` is an unconstrained predicate, not defined as having a supporter. `BearerAncestryDependentsSupported` says that each existing ancestor of a bearer of an occurring thought that satisfies `Dependent` has an existing direct supporter at w.
note: Stipulated for the source-free #562 investigation; docs/notes/bearer-regress.md gives ordinary-language meaning, examples and rivals. A sourced sense of existential dependence would need a pinned reading and is not identified with this predicate.
